title: 34th sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/34/2024).
Approval of the minutes of five previous sittings (minutes Nos. 29/2024 to 33/2024).

From the Speaker's desk: the names of three persons appointed by the President to the Cabinet on 30 September 2024 under Article 129(a) of the Constitution are sent to the relevant standing committee, so Parliament can decide on consent under Article 129(d).

From the Speaker's desk: under Article 115(d) of the Constitution and Article 14 of the Foreign Service Act (Law No. 20/2021), the President's nominee for Ambassador of the Maldives to the Republic of India is sent to the relevant standing committee.

From the Speaker's desk: the President's nominee for appointment as a member of the Elections Commission, under Article 4(a) of the Elections Commission Act (Law No. 8/2008), is sent to the relevant standing committee.

From the Speaker's desk: the President's request for Parliament's consent, under Article 93(a) of the Constitution, for the Maldives to join the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) is sent to the relevant standing committee.
First reading of the bill amending Law No. 10/2011 (Goods and Services Tax Act), submitted on behalf of the government by Maafannu West MP Mohamed Mustafa Ibrahim.

First reading of the bill amending Law No. 29/2016 (Act on Taxes and Fees Collected from Passengers Departing the Maldives from an Airport), submitted on behalf of the government by Gemanafushi MP Asadhulla Shihab.
First reading of the bill amending Law No. 2/99 (Maldives Tourism Act), submitted on behalf of the government by Machchangolhi South MP Mustafa Hussain.
Public Finance Committee report on the audit reports of the Ministry of Environment and Energy for 2012 to 2017 and of the Ministry of Environment for 2018.
Public Finance Committee report on the audit reports of the Ministry of Defence and National Security for 2012 to 2017 and of the Ministry of Defence for 2018 to 2022.
Public Finance Committee report on the assessment of expenses incurred in building a two-storey building on the land of the Noonu (Miladhunmadulu Dhekunuburi) Atoll Council secretariat.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to send new Cabinet, ambassador and Elections Commission nominations plus IAEA membership to committees, introduce three tax bills, and take up three audit reports.
